findings.text: the record written to --receipt omits "near_x_geometry", which _render_panel computes at :2795 and only prints to stdout, so no committed path writes the block all five committed receipts carry; those came from the out-of-tree recompute_near_x.py in the run directory, and _merge_receipt at :2539 preserves a key absent from the record, so a re-render keeps a stale block rather than recomputing it, and the evidence fragment's sentence 'The producer now writes it' is false.

_solve_block reads scheduler.job_id from the sweep receipt, which records 1337191 for the titan regeneration solve, while the committed receipt carries 1337259 with a superseded_job_id key _solve_block never emits; because :2550 now treats 'solve' as a replaced block, a re-render reverts the corrected provenance and drops the superseded value.

the comment says 'Four trace no cycle at all' while PERSISTED_STATE_TERMS pins three states (2, 3, 7) at cycle_component_count 0 and two (0, 8) at 1, and the docstring at :885 says 'eight trace a cycle ... and one admits no cycle either', so both counts contradict the table beside them and a reader cannot tell which mechanism each open state exhibits.

the docstring says 'State 19 carries its own wider control displacement', but state 19 has no control_displacement entry and runs at the 1.0e-3 default; the wider values belong to state 4 (5.0e-2) and state 1 (1.0e-2) at :834-835, so the sentence names the wrong state for the one pin a reader would use to understand the table.

_near_x_geometry_agrees re-derives two_cell_threshold_m with the identical expression the producer uses at benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:2405, so the assertion holds whatever the threshold rule does; it can catch a block copied from a figure with different display distances but cannot fail on a regression in the rule it appears to guard, and part of the durability score rests on it.

_finite_tree/_strict_json duplicate a capability the repository already owns rather than extending an owner: benchmarks/plasma_cell_production_ladder.py:45 strict_json has the same non-finite-to-null semantics, and benchmarks/fieldnull_candidate_audit.py:103 and benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:3265 carry the same helper plus a writer, so this is a fifth copy.
